name: B10-0387/2025 (PPE) – Gaza at breaking point: EU action to combat famine and the urgent need to release hostages and move towards a two-state solution
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Gaza at breaking point: EU action to combat famine, the urgent need to release hostages and move towards a two-state solution
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for all Israeli hostages held in Gaza to be freed immediately and without conditions. It supports Israel's right to defend itself and the goal of defeating Hamas's military wing. It expresses deep concern about hunger and lack of aid in Gaza and demands full, rapid and safe humanitarian access. It also calls for a lasting ceasefire once hostages are released, and restates support for a negotiated two-state solution.

- This is the Parliament's opinion and request; it does not change any law.
- It affects Israel, Hamas, Palestinian authorities, aid bodies and Gaza civilians.
- Next, the text goes to the Council, Commission and other named bodies.
